lines.text: Understand nomination, court authority and estate duties before moving money, and check the local process if you cannot accept the executor role.

items.text: Locate the original will and any amendments.
If unsure about serving, ask about declining before undertaking substantive administration.
Gather an initial map of assets, debts and ownership.
Keep a dated decision and expense record from the start.

line.text: It records where things stand on proving that authority, so nobody discovers at a bank counter that being named is not the same as being able to act.
